slides.label: 07 Makwa7 workflow
slides.title: Secure business verification with Makwa7
slides.subtitle: A secure process for collecting documents and verifying First Nations businesses

steps.title: Business registration
steps.text: Completes SimpleSurvey; receives a unique business ID

steps.title: Document submission
steps.text: Makwa7 upload portal: ID, email and supporting documents

steps.title: Secure storage in M-Files
steps.text: Makwa7 data centre on First Nation land in Kamloops

steps.title: Verification result
steps.text: Business ID and verification status recorded once approved

returnLoop.text: If information is missing: the business is asked to upload additional documents

output.text: Sent to downstream storage for directory and reporting use

slides.keyMessage: Power BI supports the public business directory. M-Files manages the private documents and verification process behind it.

slides.label: 08 Makwa7 status
slides.title: Makwa7: current status and next steps
currentStatus: Makwa7 configured the document upload and M-Files verification workflow
Makwa7 introduced the workflow and began onboarding COO staff
COO purchased a dedicated verification workstation
COO is reviewing the VM option for a controlled connection to Makwa7’s environment

nextSteps.text: M-Files training; test access for Sonnet and Mihir
Confirm VM scope, cost and responsibilities; secure the COO workstation
End-to-end test with sample businesses, including additional-document requests
Confirm how verification status reaches COO OneDrive and Power BI
Document procedure, access management and support

slides.myRole: Coordinate the COO technical setup, test the complete data flow and document the process for ongoing operation.

openPoint.heading: Open point · to be confirmed
